name: Rownd Desktop CNC Lathe
notes: Kickstarter campaign (2023) delivered; now sold in the vendor store. Price is the Standard Package in the EU store (US store: USD 6,699); US/EU orders ship DDP. Standard includes 3-jaw chuck, quick-change tool post (10x10 mm tools), MT1 tailstock and basic tool set. Packages: 4th Axis EUR 6,236.95; Full (live tool + ATC + air cooling) EUR 7,127.95; Full Servo Edition (closed-loop servos on X/Z/C) EUR 8,018.95. Swing = listed max. workpiece diameter; turning length = max. workpiece length (275 mm on the Standard page, 285 mm on the package pages); spindle bore = listed chuck inner diameter.

accessories.name: Automatic Tool Changer (ATC) Add-On
accessories.description: 4-tool automatic tool changer controlled via G-code for multi-operation programs without manual tool changes.

accessories.name: 4th Axis Spindle Kit (Live Tool) Add-On
accessories.description: 400 W ER11 live-tool spindle that adds milling, cross drilling and slotting to the lathe.

accessories.name: Air Cooling Add-On
accessories.description: Compressed-air blast (external 6-8 bar compressor) with G-code controlled solenoid valve for tool cooling and chip removal.

accessories.name: ER-32 Collet Chuck Set
accessories.description: ER32 collet chuck with 80 mm flange for even 360-degree clamping and lower runout than the 3-jaw chuck.

accessories.name: Tool Set
accessories.description: Starter set with inserts, drills, milling cutters and tool holders for the Rownd lathe.
